images.note: Real screenshot from an official Prometheus blog post, showing Prometheus's own built-in Alerts page: firing alert rules (red/pink, with active instance counts, labels, and Silence links) and non-firing rules (green, 0 active).

imageNote: This screenshot shows Prometheus's own Alerts page (where rules fire before being pushed to Alertmanager), not the separate Alertmanager web UI itself — no genuine, current screenshot of the standalone Alertmanager UI or Grafana's Alerting UI was found and verified during research, so the lesson is captioned accurately around what the image actually shows rather than mislabeling it. The alerting-rule and alertmanager.yml routing config snippets are original, correct-syntax YAML applied to the fictional Northbridge checkout service.
